title: Amazon Renews The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power for Season 4
excerpt:
Prime Video has officially ordered a fourth season of its Tolkien fantasy series.
Filming is scheduled to begin in the UK in spring 2027.
body_md:
The renewal arrives as Prime Video prepares to release the final two episodes of the third season on November 24, 2026. The next installment is already in pre-production, with principal photography scheduled for Shepperton Studios in the United Kingdom. A streaming premiere date has not been announced.

Showrunners and executive producers J.D. Payne and Patrick McKay will return, putting speculation about a change in creative leadership to rest. The pair have consistently described a five-season vision for their adaptation of Tolkien's Second Age. The fourth-season order moves that plan closer to completion without constituting an official renewal for a fifth season.

Season three advances the story seven years beyond the events of season two, beginning amid the War of the Elves and Sauron. Charlie Vickers returns as the Dark Lord, whose efforts to forge the One Ring provide a major narrative milestone for the adaptation.

Peter Friedlander, head of global television at Amazon MGM Studios, emphasized the importance of the series to Prime Video and expressed support for Payne, McKay and the wider creative team. The renewal indicates that Amazon intends to continue exploring the history of Middle-earth despite the show's divisive reception.

Viewership has been a subject of debate since the series premiered, particularly following reports of declining audiences during its second season. Prime Video nevertheless reports that season three reached 33 million viewers worldwide in the first 12 days after its November 11 premiere, placing it among the service's ten most-watched returning seasons. Nielsen's debut-week figures had not yet been released. Different measurement methodologies make direct comparisons between these figures difficult.

The third-season ensemble includes Morfydd Clark, Robert Aramayo, Jamie Campbell Bower, Ismael Cruz Cordova, Benjamin Walker and Vickers. Charlotte Brändström also serves as an executive producer and director. While the fourth season is now confirmed, the timing and formal approval of a potential fifth installment remain open questions.
seo_title: The Rings of Power Officially Renewed for Season 4
seo_description: Amazon renews The Rings of Power for season four, with returning showrunners and filming scheduled for spring 2027.
